summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Corporación America Airports S.A., reporting May 2026 passenger traffic statistics. No special-situation event (merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, etc.) is described. The filing discloses a 0.2% year-on-year decrease in total passenger traffic, with domestic traffic down 8.5% and international traffic up 7.3%. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are mentioned. As a monthly operational update, this filing does not indicate a special situation; it is standard reporting for a foreign private issuer.
